register.labelZh: GET AROUND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GET AROUND Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: get around 可以說明人們怎樣在城市、島嶼、公園或其他地方四處走動。；get around to 可以表示你終於抽出時間處理一直打算完成的事情。；get around 可以表示消息、事情、傳聞或其他資訊已傳給很多人知道。；get around somebody 可以表示透過特別友善、主動幫忙或討好的方式說服某人。
register.summaryEn: Get around can explain how people travel through a city, island, park or other place. Get around to helps you explain that you finally found time for something you had intended to do. Get around can show that news, a story, a rumour or other information has become known to many people. Get around somebody can describe persuading a person by being especially friendly, helpful or charming.

談論擱置了一段時間的事情
描述以友善或討好的方式說服別人
contextsEn: Talk clearly about moving through places
Talk about tasks that have been waiting

fixedVariable.variableZh: get around somebody 本身已是完整表達。句子可以加入額外資料,說明說服的方法,但這些資料並非固定表達的一部分。；get around to 後面可以接一件事物,亦可以接 -ing 形式。；留意句子的主語,因為相同字詞可以表達不同意思。遊客在城市內四處走動。消息在城市內傳開。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Get around somebody is complete by itself. An extra phrase may explain how the person persuaded them, but it is optional. She got around her uncle. She got around her uncle with a friendly smile. After get around to, use a thing or an -ing form. get around to the report get around to writing the report Read the subject carefully because the same words may express different ideas. Tourists get around the city. News gets around the city.
